bio: In the setting of this picturesque centuries-old castle, you can savour classic cuisine with an Austrian twist. The dishes are meticulously crafted from first-rate ingredients including organic beef from the restaurant's own on-site farm. Be sure to try the Wiener schnitzel and the Tafelspitz (prime boiled beef) – the side dishes are also excellent, such as the exquisite creamed spinach. Adept service comes courtesy of a friendly front-of-house team. Delightful terrace....
